Incoterms 2020

危険物

Substances or articles classified by UN Model Regulations as posing risks to health, safety, property, or environment during transport.

Quick answer

Why it matters

危険物 matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 危険物?

In this glossary, 危険物 refers to: Substances or articles classified by UN Model Regulations as posing risks to health, safety, property, or environment during transport.

How is 危険物 used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "荷送人はUN承認の危険物梱包証明書を提供し、各荷物に適切に表示しなければなりません。"

Why does 危険物 matter in logistics?

危険物 matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses 危険物?

危険物 is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does 危険物 belong to?

In this glossary, 危険物 is grouped under Incoterms 2020. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

Substances or articles classified by UN Model Regulations as posing risks to health, safety, property, or environment during transport.

Operational example

The shipper must provide a UN‑approved DG packing certificate and mark each Dangerous Goods package accordingly.
